DEC-0091 got an operator-answered event (keep-fix-806) at 2026-10-13T04:47:09Z with no by and no rationale, written by the answer subcommand run without flags. The operator chose delete-guard on DEC-0092. The PR lets supersede close an answer that names no author and makes the answer subcommand require --by and --rationale. The executor role policy refuses supersede, so dispatch or the planner writes the catalog event after merge.
